title: Train window drift
prompt_en: 21:9 shot from inside a moving train. Rain streaks on the window, countryside lights blur past outside, a passenger's reflection faintly visible. Slow, melancholic, cool blue tones.
prompt_zh: 21:9 从行驶中的火车内拍摄。雨丝划过车窗，窗外乡村灯光模糊掠过，乘客的倒影隐约可见。缓慢、忧郁、冷蓝色调。
why_it_works: Layered depth (drops, reflection, outside motion) produces a cinematic mood with minimal character action.
